changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE maintenance_payments ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
flat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
billing_start_date DATE NOT NULL, billing_end_date DATE NOT NULL,
billing_cycle VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, months_covered INT NOT NULL,
monthly_fee DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, final_amount DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
payment_date DATE, transaction_id VARCHAR(255), payment_method VARCHAR(100),
payment_gateway_response TEXT, reference_number VARCHAR(255),
-- Auditable Fields (from AuditableEntity) created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
-- Foreign Keys CONSTRAINT fk_payment_flat FOREIGN KEY (flat_id) REFERENCES flats(id), CONSTRAINT fk_payment_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) );
